title: Tennessee ratifies women's suffrage in the United States
summary: Tennessee became the 36th state to ratify the Nineteenth Amendment, giving it the support needed to guarantee American women the right to vote.
reason: Decades of campaigning by suffragists and women's wartime contribution built support for the amendment.
significance: It enfranchised millions of women and was a milestone for women's rights worldwide.
place: Tennessee State Capitol, Nashville, United States
wikipedia: Nineteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
